name: – Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu – § 20 – Am 12
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 20. Reaffirms the goal of creating a ‘Tobacco-Free Generation’ by 2040; calls for the Commission to present, in due time, a proposal for the revision of the EU’s tobacco legislation taking into consideration the principles of Better Regulation and the requirement for rural proofing, and ensuring that such revision is firmly based on the best available independent scientific evidence, while taking into account the impact it might have on tobacco-growing regions, rural employment and agricultural supply chains;
